trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Initiated rollback to v2.3.0 in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east completed, with an orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollback completed across all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0 (on-call paged).

4. **Verified**: Final status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.
